$comment: What the cache doesn't hold about Smithing. Anvil products (level, bars, amount) come from cache enums 844-846 and their slots from anvil-layout.json (yarn dump:smithing); this file has the furnace recipes and the experience. Item keys are ItemIdentifiers names.
$smelting: Furnace recipes in Smelt-menu order (rsprox captures, rev 227-235 normal worlds: Bronze, Blurite, Iron, Silver, Steel, Gold, Mithril, Adamantite, Runite). Messages: rev 237 captures where docs/smithing.md says so, the same pattern otherwise.

smelting.name: Bronze bar
smelting.smeltMessage: You smelt the copper and tin together in the furnace.
smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of bronze.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one copper ore and one tin ore to smelt a bronze bar.

smelting.name: Blurite bar
smelting.smeltMessage: You smelt the blurite in the furnace.
smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of blurite.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one blurite ore to smelt a blurite bar.

smelting.name: Iron bar

smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of iron.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one iron ore to smelt an iron bar.

smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one silver ore to smelt a silver bar.

smelting.name: Gold bar

smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of gold.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one gold ore to smelt a gold bar.

smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of mithril.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one mithril ore and four coal to smelt a mithril bar.

smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of adamantite.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one adamantite ore and six coal to smelt an adamantite bar.

smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of runite.

smelting.retrieveMessage: You retrieve a bar of lovakite.
smelting.missingMessage: You need at least one lovakite ore and two coal to smelt a lovakite bar.

smelting.name: 'perfect' gold bar
smelting.missingMessage: You need 'perfect' gold ore to smelt this bar.

smelting.retrieveMessage: You smelt the 'perfect' gold ore into a bar.
smelting.$comment: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/'perfect'_gold_bar - Family Crest's quest bar; the Gold bar choice uses its ore when no normal gold ore is held.

smelting.name: Molten glass
smelting.missingMessage: You need sand and soda ash to make glass.
smelting.retrieveMessage: You heat the sand and soda ash in the furnace to make glass.
smelting.$comment: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Molten_glass - Crafting; sand or soda ash used on a furnace.

$cannonballs: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cannonball - any furnace with an ammo mould (1 bar -> 4) or double ammo mould (2 bars -> 8, same speed); needs Dwarf Cannon. 8 ticks, then 10 between. XP per bar from each ball's page. No captures.
$blurite: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Blurite_bar - blurite isn't on the smithing interface; a blurite bar used on an anvil (or Smith with only blurite) opens a menu of these. The Knight's Sword.
$spears: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barbarian_Training#Smithing - a bar and a matching log make a spear or a hasta at a barbarian anvil only; same level and experience for both, 4 ticks.
$phrases: The end of 'You hammer the <metal> and make <phrase>' per anvil slot label (Shayzien labels without their tier); objPhrases win for one product. rsprox captures (rev 237) where docs/smithing.md says so, the same wording otherwise.
$xpPerBar: Smithing#Smithing_tables: anvil experience is per bar used, whatever the product.
$productXp: Products whose experience isn't the bar's per-bar rate times the bars used.
